blocks.content: Imagine we have the following list.
Suppose we need to insert a node 10 at the beginning, we follow the given steps:
1. Traverse to the last node of the list.
To insert a node at the beginning, we first traverse to the last node of the list.

blocks.alt: Traverse to the last node of the list

blocks.content: 2. Make the last node point to the new node
To link the nodes, we set the next of the last node (where we are currently in) to the new node.

blocks.alt: Link Last Node to New Node

blocks.content: 3. Make the new node point to the head node and then make it the new head node.
Since we are adding a new node at the beginning, the new node is set as the head of the list.

// new_node is the head
head = new_node;

blocks.alt: Insert at the Beginning of Circular Linked List
